claims.statement: On the pinned T22 order-91 control, the eligible selected aggregate is -498754180547001418536 even though the distinguished selected tag has g=212336130412243110 (k*g=7007092303604022630 for k=33); therefore any budget requiring every tag to pay its own local demand fails on this control.
claims.scope: Exact arithmetic for the single pinned T22 control row in inputs/standing-controls/t22-order91.json; applies only to pointwise/tagwise charging and does not refute a global cross-tag map or the primary aggregate.
claims.reason: The positive marked-tag contribution and all 66 equal negative star-tag contributions are listed in the hash-verified control row; exact multiplication and summation are replayed in the worker evidence. No full-network incidence data is specified in the read-first assignment, so this is a bounded mechanism obstruction, not a global Hall-cut or kernel certificate.

limitations: The read-first assignment does not provide enough basis, incidence, weight, and mixed-boundary rules to instantiate the named global unsigned two-for-one Hall relation.
The T22 control values are taken from the pinned standing-control row; this route replays their arithmetic but does not independently recompute the graph polynomial or selector.
The local positive tag is not a deficient cut for a network that permits cross-tag transfers, and the negative full aggregate does not resolve the primary claim.
